about.title: About
about.description: Emirhan Durmuşkaya: entrepreneur in İstanbul, member of FRC Turing Robotics, and writer.
about.entrepreneur: I am an entrepreneur based in İstanbul. I founded Valmeto, a B2B international trading company that supplies non-ferrous metals.
about.robotics: I am a member of Turing Robotics (FRC #10141), the FIRST Robotics Competition team of Halil Bekmezci Anadolu Lisesi. The team won “Regional Winners” at the 2026 İstanbul Regional and qualified for the FIRST Championship in Houston.
about.roleTodo: My role on the team: TODO
about.writing: I research and write on science (especially physics), philosophy (religion, science, ontology) and history. My essays have been published as “ufens” on Evrim Ağacı, Academia and my own blogs; all of them are also listed here, in the Writing section.
